evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Establishing a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to stability/readiness (conservation) and capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to mastery-as-practiced rather than mastery-as-claimed.
Restating the cadence as a labeled property reinforces the stability and regularity of the practice.
Naming an owner assigns self-origination and accountability for the practice, appealing to autonomy as the good of owning one's domain.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is mastery here being equated with practiced readiness rather than asserted possession?
